tasks.title: Add @fontsource dependencies
produces: `node_modules/@fontsource/inter/files/` and `node_modules/@fontsource/jetbrains-mono/files/` exist and contain latin `*-normal.woff2` files.

tasks.title: Create fonts.css @font-face and import it in main.tsx
expects: `@fontsource/inter` and `@fontsource/jetbrains-mono` woff2 files are present under `node_modules/@fontsource/*/files/` (Task 001 Produces).
produces: `src/renderer/src/assets/fonts.css` exists and declares 6 `@font-face` rules: `Inter` (400/500/600/700) and `JetBrains Mono` (400/700).
Every `@font-face` in `fonts.css` sets `font-display: swap` and a `src: url(...) format('woff2')` that resolves to a bundled `@fontsource` woff2 (no remote URL).

tasks.title: Reorder --font-sans and point base.css body at the token
expects: `fonts.css` loads Inter and JetBrains Mono (Task 002 Produces) so the reordered token resolves to a real face.
produces: In `tokens.css`, `--font-sans` lists `'Inter'` before `-apple-system`, and carries the restore-to-`tokens.json` comment.
In `base.css`, the `body` rule's `font-family` is `var(--font-sans)` (the hardcoded literal stack is removed); the antialiasing / `optimizeLegibility` declarations are retained.

tasks.title: Document self-hosted fonts in the styles concern doc
produces: `docs/renderer/styles/index.md` names `fonts.css` and records that Inter and JetBrains Mono are self-hosted via `@font-face` / `@fontsource`.

tasks.title: Font-load fidelity CT and regenerate baselines
expects: `--font-sans` is reordered Inter-first and `base.css` body uses `var(--font-sans)` (Task 003 Produces).
produces: A CT test asserting `document.fonts` has Inter + JetBrains Mono loaded AND `getComputedStyle().fontFamily` resolves to Inter (sans) / JetBrains Mono (mono).
The affected CT screenshot baselines are regenerated (stale PNGs deleted + re-created).
